name: The Chiapothecary
intro: This is for your chia routine. Set a jar the night before, or keep one in the fridge for any time.

energising.label: a pudding to wake you up

pudding-jars.label: Mix an experiment
pudding-jars.ref: the pudding jars on the counter

songbird.label: The clockwork songbird
songbird.moment: Wind her up and she sings. A real tūī taught her the song.
songbird.moment_quiet: Wind her up. Turn the sound on, by the bell, and you'll hear her sing.

scales.label: The scales
scales.moment: Three spoons of chia to a cup of milk. The scales agree with me, which is nice.
moments: They're older than the jars. I trust them anyway.
I check them against a bag of flour. They've never complained.

mortar.label: The mortar and pestle
mortar.moment: For cardamom and cinnamon. Ground fresh, a pinch goes a long way.
moments: Stone, and heavier than it looks. It does most of the work.
It still smells faintly of cardamom.

botanical-print.label: The chia plant
botanical-print.moment: That's chia in flower. It's a kind of sage, and the seeds come from those little purple spikes.
moments: Framed by someone who really liked seeds.
The flowers go to seed fast, and then the work begins.

drawer-black-chia.label: Black chia
drawer-black-chia.moment: Black chia. Stir it into milk, wait five minutes, stir again, and leave it overnight.

drawer-white-chia.label: White chia
drawer-white-chia.moment: White chia. It looks prettier in a jar and tastes exactly the same as the black.

drawer-coconut-flakes.label: Coconut flakes
drawer-coconut-flakes.moment: Toast them in a dry pan for a couple of minutes, until they go golden. Don't walk away.

drawer-cacao-nibs.label: Cacao nibs
drawer-cacao-nibs.moment: Cacao nibs. Bitter and crunchy, like chocolate before anyone's added the sugar.

drawer-goji-berries.label: Goji berries
drawer-goji-berries.moment: Goji berries. Soak them for ten minutes and they plump right up.

drawer-matcha.label: Matcha
drawer-matcha.moment: Matcha. Half a teaspoon is plenty, and it'll wake you up.

chia-lane-window.label: The lane
chia-lane-window.moment: The same lane Sweet Spells looks out on. On a quiet day you can hear its music box across the hall.
moments: Nobody hurries down that lane. I've never once seen anyone run.
The cobbles are older than the Inn, and they let you know it.

chia-glasshouse-door.label: Into the Conservatory
chia-glasshouse-door.ref: the glass door to the Conservatory

chia-dial.label: The dial
chia-dial.map: The dial by the hallway door

atoms.title: The basic chia pudding
atoms.hook: Three spoons of chia to a cup of oat milk, left overnight.
atoms.method_short: Three tablespoons of chia to a cup of oat milk. Stir, wait five minutes, stir again, then overnight in the fridge.

seed.name: Basic overnight chia pudding
seed.why: The base for every jar in here.

atoms.body: Three tablespoons of chia to a cup of oat milk. Stir, wait five minutes, stir again, then overnight in the fridge.

atoms.title: Make tomorrow's breakfast tonight
atoms.hook: Two minutes of stirring, and breakfast is waiting in the fridge.
atoms.method_short: Two minutes before bed: chia, oat milk, a stir, a lid. Breakfast is waiting in the fridge.

seed.name: Two-minute overnight chia jar
seed.why: Tomorrow's breakfast, made while the kettle boils.

atoms.body: Two minutes before bed: chia, oat milk, a stir, a lid. Breakfast is waiting in the fridge.

atoms.title: A week of chia in four jars
atoms.hook: One batch of chia, four jars, a different topping each day.
atoms.method_short: Make a big batch of plain chia pudding and split it into jars. Top each one differently through the week.

seed.name: Batch chia pudding for the week
seed.why: Four breakfasts from ten minutes' work. It keeps for four days in the fridge.

atoms.body: Make a big batch of plain chia pudding and split it into jars. Top each one differently through the week.

atoms.title: A small jar for any time of day
atoms.hook: A few spoons of chia with yoghurt and fruit, ready any time.
atoms.method_short: A few spoons of chia pudding from the fridge, with yoghurt and whatever fruit is about. A snack that's already made.

seed.name: Chia, yoghurt and berry snack pots
seed.why: Ready in the fridge for any time of day.

atoms.body: A few spoons of chia pudding from the fridge, with yoghurt and whatever fruit is about. A snack that's already made.

atoms.title: Matcha chia with lime
atoms.hook: Matcha chia with lime and maple, with a bit of a lift.
atoms.method_short: Matcha whisked into a little warm oat milk, topped up cold and set with chia. Lime and maple syrup to finish.

seed.name: Matcha and lime chia pudding
seed.why: Matcha has caffeine, so it's a pudding with a bit of a lift.

atoms.body: Matcha whisked into a little warm oat milk, topped up cold and set with chia. Lime and maple syrup to finish.

atoms.title: Peanut butter and banana chia
atoms.hook: Chia stirred with peanut butter and layered with banana.
atoms.method_short: Chia pudding stirred with peanut butter and layered with sliced banana. Filling enough for a long morning.

seed.name: Peanut butter and banana chia pudding
seed.why: Peanut butter adds protein, so it keeps you going for longer.

atoms.body: Chia pudding stirred with peanut butter and layered with sliced banana. Filling enough for a long morning.

atoms.title: Blueberry and walnut chia
atoms.hook: Chia with blueberries and walnuts, for a steady start.
atoms.method_short: Plain chia pudding with blueberries and chopped walnuts. A steady breakfast for a day of thinking.

seed.name: Blueberry and walnut chia pudding
seed.why: Walnuts and chia both bring omega-3 fats, and the protein and fibre make for a steady start.

atoms.body: Plain chia pudding with blueberries and chopped walnuts. A steady breakfast for a day of thinking.

atoms.title: Kiwi and orange chia
atoms.hook: Chia set in orange juice, with kiwifruit and orange on top.
atoms.method_short: Chia set overnight in orange juice, topped with sliced kiwifruit and orange. Bright and sharp.

seed.name: Kiwi and orange chia pudding
seed.why: Kiwifruit and oranges are both high in vitamin C, which your body uses to make collagen.

atoms.body: Chia set overnight in orange juice, topped with sliced kiwifruit and orange. Bright and sharp.

atoms.title: Mango and coconut chia
atoms.hook: Chia in coconut milk, with mango, lime and toasted coconut.
atoms.method_short: Chia set in coconut milk, with blitzed mango, toasted coconut and lime on top.

seed.name: Mango and coconut chia pudding
seed.why: Mango brings vitamin C and a taste of somewhere sunnier.

atoms.body: Chia set in coconut milk, with blitzed mango, toasted coconut and lime on top.

atoms.title: Raspberry and mint chia, served cold
atoms.hook: Raspberries and mint layered with chia, served cold.
atoms.method_short: Raspberries mashed with torn mint, layered with chia set in oat milk. Eat it straight from the fridge.

seed.name: Raspberry and mint chia jars
seed.why: Cold and sharp when it's hot out.

atoms.body: Raspberries mashed with torn mint, layered with chia set in oat milk. Eat it straight from the fridge.

atoms.title: Warm cinnamon and cardamom chia
atoms.hook: Chia stirred into oat milk warmed with cinnamon and cardamom.
atoms.method_short: Oat milk warmed with cinnamon and cardamom, then chia stirred in and left ten minutes off the heat. Like porridge, but quicker.

seed.name: Warm cinnamon and cardamom chia
seed.why: A warm jar for a cold morning, with no overnight wait.

atoms.body: Oat milk warmed with cinnamon and cardamom, then chia stirred in and left ten minutes off the heat. Like porridge, but quicker.

atoms.title: Golden turmeric chia
atoms.hook: Chia in warm coconut milk with turmeric, ginger and cinnamon.
atoms.method_short: Warm coconut milk with turmeric, ginger, cinnamon and a pinch of pepper, stirred into chia and left to thicken. Mild and warming.

seed.name: Golden chia pudding with coconut milk
seed.why: Warm and gently spiced, for slowing down.

atoms.body: Warm coconut milk with turmeric, ginger, cinnamon and a pinch of pepper, stirred into chia and left to thicken. Mild and warming.

atoms.title: Chamomile and vanilla chia
atoms.hook: Chia set in chamomile milk, with vanilla and honey.
atoms.method_short: Chamomile steeped in warm milk, then cooled with vanilla and chia. A spoon of honey. Mild and gentle.

seed.name: Chamomile and vanilla chia pudding
seed.why: A quiet, mild jar for slowing down.

atoms.body: Chamomile steeped in warm milk, then cooled with vanilla and chia. A spoon of honey. Mild and gentle.

atoms.title: Chocolate chia with cacao nibs
atoms.hook: Cocoa chia in coconut milk, with crunchy cacao nibs on top.
atoms.method_short: Cocoa and a little maple syrup stirred into coconut milk before the chia goes in. Cacao nibs on top for crunch.

seed.name: Chocolate chia pudding with cacao nibs
seed.why: Rich and chocolatey, and still mostly seeds and coconut milk.

atoms.body: Cocoa and a little maple syrup stirred into coconut milk before the chia goes in. Cacao nibs on top for crunch.

atoms.title: Why chia turns liquid into pudding
atoms.hook: Each chia seed swells into a soft gel. That's the whole trick.
atoms.method_short: Each seed has a coat of soluble fibre that soaks up liquid and swells into a soft gel. That's the whole trick.

seed.name: Chia jam with berries
seed.why: The same gel, setting fruit instead of milk.

atoms.body: Each seed has a coat of soluble fibre that soaks up liquid and swells into a soft gel. That's the whole trick.

atoms.title: What's in a spoon of chia
atoms.hook: Fibre, some plant protein and a plant omega-3, in two spoons.
atoms.method_short: Chia seeds bring fibre, some plant protein and ALA, a plant omega-3. Two tablespoons is a usual serving.

seed.name: Overnight chia with oats and seeds
seed.why: Chia with oats and seeds for a fuller jar.

atoms.body: Chia seeds bring fibre, some plant protein and ALA, a plant omega-3. Two tablespoons is a usual serving.

atoms.title: Strawberry and vanilla chia
atoms.hook: Chia set in oat milk with vanilla, under sliced strawberries.
atoms.method_short: Stir chia into oat milk with vanilla and a little maple syrup, and leave overnight. Top with sliced strawberries.

seed.name: Strawberry and vanilla chia pudding
seed.why: Strawberries bring vitamin C, and the first ones come in late spring.

atoms.body: Stir chia into oat milk with vanilla and a little maple syrup, and leave overnight. Top with sliced strawberries.

atoms.title: Passionfruit and coconut chia
atoms.hook: Chia in coconut milk with passionfruit pulp and lime on top.
atoms.method_short: Stir chia into coconut milk with a little maple syrup, and leave overnight. Spoon over passionfruit pulp and lime zest.

seed.name: Passionfruit and coconut chia pudding
seed.why: Sharp passionfruit over creamy coconut, cold from the fridge.

atoms.body: Stir chia into coconut milk with a little maple syrup, and leave overnight. Spoon over passionfruit pulp and lime zest.

atoms.title: Feijoa and lime chia
atoms.hook: Chia in oat milk, layered with mashed feijoa and lime.
atoms.method_short: Set chia in oat milk overnight. Mash feijoa flesh with lime and a little maple, and layer it through the jar.

seed.name: Feijoa and lime chia pudding
seed.why: Feijoas only come for a few weeks in autumn.

atoms.body: Set chia in oat milk overnight. Mash feijoa flesh with lime and a little maple, and layer it through the jar.

atoms.title: Mandarin and ginger chia
atoms.hook: Chia set in orange juice with ginger, topped with mandarin.
atoms.method_short: Stir chia into orange juice with a pinch of ground ginger and leave overnight. Top with mandarin segments.

seed.name: Mandarin and ginger chia pudding
seed.why: Mandarins are at their best in winter, and full of vitamin C.

atoms.body: Stir chia into orange juice with a pinch of ground ginger and leave overnight. Top with mandarin segments.

atoms.title: Kefir and kiwifruit chia
atoms.hook: Chia set in kefir, with sliced kiwifruit and a little honey.
atoms.method_short: Stir chia into kefir with a little honey and leave it overnight. Top with sliced kiwifruit.

seed.name: Kefir and kiwifruit chia pudding
seed.why: Kefir is a fermented milk, tangy like a pourable yoghurt.

atoms.body: Stir chia into kefir with a little honey and leave it overnight. Top with sliced kiwifruit.

atoms.title: Yoghurt, oat and apple chia
atoms.hook: Chia, oats and yoghurt set together, with grated apple and cinnamon.
atoms.method_short: Mix chia and oats into yoghurt thinned with a splash of milk. Leave overnight, then stir in grated apple and cinnamon.

seed.name: Overnight chia with yoghurt, oats and apple
seed.why: Yoghurt, oats and chia, all set together in one jar.

atoms.body: Mix chia and oats into yoghurt thinned with a splash of milk. Leave overnight, then stir in grated apple and cinnamon.

atoms.title: Chai-spiced chia
atoms.hook: Chia in oat milk with cinnamon, cardamom, ginger and maple.
atoms.method_short: Warm the oat milk with the spices, stir in chia and maple, and leave it overnight.

seed.name: Chai-spiced chia pudding
seed.why: The warm spices of a chai, in a jar.

atoms.body: Warm the oat milk with the spices, stir in chia and maple, and leave it overnight.
